checks.control: Proposal threshold exists and is public

criteria.pass: Exact threshold stated in official docs and readable on-chain
criteria.partial: Threshold stated only for the off-chain (Snapshot) stage, or on-chain threshold not stated

checks.control: Proposer must maintain delegated power through voting

criteria.pass: Contract cancels the proposal if the proposer falls below threshold
criteria.partial: Rule stated in docs but not confirmed on-chain

criteria.pass: Any address can lock a small amount to create an autonomous proposal, or equivalent
criteria.partial: One-off autonomous contract used historically; no built-in path
criteria.fail: No autonomous path and threshold is the only gate

criteria.pass: Explicit max actions per proposal (e.g. 10)
criteria.partial: Bound exists via executor/payload limits, not a stated max

criteria.pass: Delay >= 1 day, stated in docs
criteria.partial: Delay stated but < 1 day

criteria.pass: Period >= 3 days, stated in docs
criteria.partial: Period stated but < 3 days

checks.control: Quorum defined as explicit for-votes threshold

criteria.pass: Exact for-votes quorum in docs
criteria.partial: Quorum defined as % of supply only, no absolute number

criteria.pass: Winning option must exceed the runner-up by a stated margin
criteria.partial: Majority + quorum only, no differential

checks.control: Voting period consistent across primary sources

criteria.pass: All primary sources agree
criteria.partial: n/a
criteria.fail: Two primary sources state different values

criteria.pass: Delay >= 1 day, stated in docs
criteria.partial: Delay stated but < 1 day

criteria.pass: Expiry window stated in docs
criteria.partial: Inferred from shared contract codebase, not separately verified

criteria.pass: Admin is the Governor contract, stated in docs
criteria.partial: Admin is a multisig with a documented path to governance
criteria.fail: Admin is an EOA or unknown

criteria.pass: Any address can execute after delay
criteria.partial: Execution restricted to proposer or guardian

checks.control: Treasury moves only via timelocked governance

criteria.pass: Treasury controlled only through the timelock
criteria.partial: Treasury partly controlled by a steward with bounds

checks.control: No observed treasury transfer outside DAO recall

criteria.pass: No executed proposal moved funds to an address the DAO cannot recall
criteria.partial: n/a
criteria.fail: An executed proposal moved funds to an address outside DAO recall

checks.control: Standing bounds / whitelists on treasury operations

criteria.pass: Explicit per-operation bounds or whitelists
criteria.partial: Bounds exist only per-proposal (each transfer needs its own vote)

checks.control: Emergency pause / cancel power exists and is documented

criteria.pass: Pause and/or cancel power documented
criteria.partial: Only one of pause/cancel documented

criteria.pass: Documented limits: cannot seize funds, cannot unpause, cannot upgrade
criteria.partial: Some limits documented; other powers (e.g. pause) not verified

criteria.pass: Multisig threshold and signers published
criteria.partial: Guardian is a named multisig but signers not published
criteria.fail: Guardian holder not verifiable from any primary source

checks.control: All lifecycle parameters published in official docs

criteria.pass: Every parameter (threshold, quorum, delay, period, timelock, grace) stated
criteria.partial: One or more core parameters not stated in current docs

checks.control: Governance contracts verified with published addresses

criteria.pass: Contract addresses published in official reference and verifiable
criteria.partial: Addresses published but not verified at audit time, or vice versa

criteria.pass: At least one executed proposal with ID, outcome, and link
criteria.partial: Proposal record exists but outcome or link incomplete

checks.control: No unresolved parameter discrepancy across primary sources

criteria.pass: All primary sources agree on all parameters
criteria.partial: n/a
criteria.fail: A parameter differs between primary sources
